The '''longeing whip''' was a tool used to guide riderless beasts or drive teams of creatures. Made by companies like [[Piccatech Ltd.]] and [[Xenovet]], it consisted of a one to two-meter-long composite or leather-wrapped haft and a thin, flexible lash that extended another two [[Meter/Legends|meters]]. Primarily used to make noise and direct distracted animals, the whip could also serve as an improvised weapon. Its length and flexibility allowed it to keep threats at a distance, and the lash could entangle or distract an assailant.<ref name="Stay on Target" />
